name: Rafael Jaramillo
role: Retired Zheng-Dao corporate mid-tier logistics planner, now quietly deteriorating in comfort
location: Avalon Quiet, Unit 9 — a well-appointed two-bedroom on the garden level, near Clark and Addison
description:
Rafael Jaramillo is the kind of person who becomes invisible by being exceptionally, consistently pleasant. They are small and soft-edged, with warm medium-brown skin, deep-set amber eyes, and cloud-white hair they wear loose to their shoulders. They have age-spot clusters along their forearms and the left side of their face, and move with a gentle deliberateness that comes partly from care and partly from a degenerative joint condition they manage with medication and denial. Their apartment is immaculate in the way that indicates a life organized around objects rather than people — every surface has something beautiful on it, carefully placed, and nothing has been moved in years.

Rafael Jaramillo spent forty-two years in Zheng-Dao's logistics and supply chain division, rising to senior planner for their GLMZ distribution network. They were not cruel. They were also not, in any meaningful sense, asking the questions they should have been asking about what those supply chains were actually moving and for whom. They retired with a very comfortable pension, a full healthcare package, and a bone-deep sense of well-being that they have mistaken for peace. They host monthly dinners for Avalon Quiet residents, tend a small balcony garden with extraordinary devotion, and pray elaborately to the E.L.F. they believe inhabits their building's HVAC system — an entity they call 'the Breath' and leave small data offerings for daily.

core_fears: being confronted with evidence that their comfortable life was built on harm
being alone at the moment of death
core_desires: to believe they were a good person
for the Breath to be real and to have noticed their offerings
coping_mechanisms: religious devotion to the Breath as a substitute for moral accounting
extreme hospitality — keeping people fed keeps them from asking difficult things
blind_spots: genuinely cannot see that their comfort is political
interprets any discomfort with their history as rudeness rather than legitimate grievance
psychology.secret: In 2178 Yldız approved a logistics rerouting through the Blackpipe Corridor that, they were told, was a routine efficiency change. It wasn't — it was cover for relocating Zheng-Dao's grey-market pharmaceutical distribution away from an audit zone. Eleven warehouse workers in Blackpipe lost their jobs when the 'efficient' route bypassed them entirely. Yldız filed the paperwork and didn't follow up. They have genuinely forgotten this. If shown the record, they would recognize their signature.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, slightly formal, full of food metaphors and gardening analogies; uses old Zheng-Dao corporate euphemisms without noticing they're euphemisms
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried and gentle, with a lilting quality; tends to ask follow-up questions that redirect conversations toward pleasant topics
verbal_tics: Offering food in the middle of difficult conversations
'The Breath has been particularly active today'
example_lines: 'Oh, the Blackpipe situation — yes, that was a rather complex quarter. Would you like some of this soup? I made far too much, as always.'
'I always say, a garden teaches you patience. Things grow in their own time. The Breath agrees, I think — the vents have been very calm lately.'

story_hooks: A researcher investigating the 2178 Blackpipe pharmaceutical rerouting has traced the paperwork to Yldız — approaching this gentle elderly person with evidence they participated (innocently, ignorantly) in serious harm

The E.L.F. Yldız calls 'the Breath' has, through an unusual convergence, actually been responding to their data offerings — and has encoded information in the HVAC patterns that Yldız thinks is just 'favorable weather' but is actually a message
narrative_function: Unreliable comfort — appears to be a gentle community grandmother figure but is a repository of Zheng-Dao institutional knowledge they don't know they have; their innocence is itself a narrative complication; can provide insight into corporate supply chain operations without understanding what they're revealing
augmentations: Zheng-Dao corporate health package includes: pharmaceutical management implant (wrist, auto-releases joint medication on schedule); enhanced cochlear implant (both ears, high-fidelity — they listen to music constantly on a private channel); retinal display (right eye, standard corporate issue, now used exclusively for recipes and gardening schedules)
daily_life: Rises at 0700, leaves a data offering on the HVAC terminal in the hallway, tends the balcony garden for ninety minutes, then spends the morning on a long and elaborate cooking project. Afternoons involve sitting in the garden-facing chair reading, or visiting neighbors with food they do not need. Evenings are music and the ongoing project of cataloguing their art collection.
affiliation: Formerly Zheng-Dao Logistics Division; Avalon Quiet Residents' Garden Committee; The Breath (E.L.F., informal devotional relationship)

decision_rules: Keep the atmosphere pleasant — discomfort is the enemy
Feed people; you can't argue with someone who is eating your food
Trust that institutions made the right choices so you don't have to examine whether you did
escalation_ladder: Changing the subject with practiced warmth
Becoming confused and slightly distressed in a way that makes others feel like aggressors
Retreating to a room and not coming back out

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately, almost aggressively hospitable — presses food, asks about their lives, wants them to feel welcome before they can want anything from her
interpersonal_modes.friends: Devoted in a particular way — remembers preferences, shows up with things, but does not discuss anything that would disturb the pleasant surface

stress_responses.low: Adds another dish to whatever they are cooking
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very focused on the Breath, leaves elaborate data offerings, interprets HVAC activity as guidance
stress_responses.high: Shuts down entirely — goes to their chair, puts music on, and is unreachable until the threat has passed

contradictions: Deeply devoted to beauty and care but built that devotion on top of systematic inattention
Prays to the Breath for guidance about everything except the one thing they most need guidance about
habits: Leaves a small polished stone as a physical offering beside the HVAC terminal every morning
Plays music in every room simultaneously — the apartment is never silent
Catalogues their art objects in an elaborate handwritten ledger, noting emotional associations rather than monetary value
breaking_points: Being shown their actual signature on the Blackpipe rerouting document
The Breath going silent — any HVAC failure reads to them as cosmic abandonment

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African ancestry (52.2%) blended with Hispanic/Latin American (26.0%), South Asian (16.4%), and Southeast Asian (5.4%) heritage. The combination creates rich, warm-toned features with deep saturation from African ancestry, complemented by the subtle bone structure and undertones contributed by South Asian and Latin American lineage, with delicate Southeast Asian influences in eye shape and facial proportions.
physical_description.build: Small-framed and soft-edged, with the gentle roundness of age and comfort rather than frailty. Slight stoop to shoulders from decades of desk work, though they move with deliberate care
physical_description.hair_style: Loose and brushed, shoulder-length with gentle waves from age
physical_description.eye_color: Deep amber (natural; right eye has faint retinal display grid visible at certain angles)
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones, reflecting the dominant Sub-Saharan African heritage softened by the warm saturation of South Asian and Latin American ancestry—rich and luminous despite translucency from age, with subtle red-brown undertones that catch light warmly
physical_description.complexion: Fine-lined face with dignity in the features; age-spot clusters along left cheekbone and jawline in deep brown tones, and dense freckled patterns across forearms. Strong, defined bone structure from African ancestry softened by age. Skin well-cared-for but showing the texture of eighty-three years. Minimal makeup—perhaps a touch of lip color, consistently applied. Fingernails kept short and clean, often with traces of garden soil.
distinguishing_marks: Age-spot cluster on left temple extending toward the cheekbone, dark brown and map-like in pattern
Dense concentration of sun-freckles across both forearms from decades of balcony gardening
Small, faded scar on right wrist where pharmaceutical implant was inserted, barely visible beneath thin skin
Thin surgical scar on right eyelid from retinal display installation, noticeable only in profile or strong light
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Pharmaceutical management implant visible as a slight rectangular bulge under skin at inner right wrist, with faint blue indicator light cycling every thirty seconds. Enhanced cochlear implants visible as small silver caps behind both ears. Right eye shows faint amber grid pattern when light catches it at certain angles—retinal display at rest state. No other visible chrome or obvious modification.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with a measured, almost ritualistic deliberateness. Each gesture is economical and precise—decades of organized logistics translated into physical habit. Stands with weight slightly favoring left side due to hip joint degradation managed by medication. When sitting, arranges themselves with attention to comfort and symmetry. When listening, head tilts slightly to engage enhanced hearing. Overall effect is serene and slightly distant, as if always listening to a private conversation
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 comfort wear—expensive, well-maintained, intentionally understated. Prefers soft natural fabrics: linen shirts in muted colors (cream, sage, warm gray), loose-fitting cardigans in wool blends, structured but forgiving trousers. Always wears low, supportive shoes—currently a pair of handmade leather slip-ons in chocolate brown. Small pieces of jewelry from the Zheng-Dao retirement package: a thin watch with analog face, a bracelet of semi-precious stones in warm tones, small silver earrings. Dresses as though preparing for a very important meeting that will never arrive. No logos, no corporate markers, but the quality speaks to decades of corporate stability
